subject.title: fix(config): bound config I/O warning and pending-secret caches

question: May an auto-generated `commands.ownerDisplaySecret` be evicted and regenerated after 4,096 distinct config paths in one process?
rationale: The changed secret module is security-owned, and regeneration changes pseudonymized owner identifiers in model-visible prompt text even though it does not change authorization.

options.title: Accept bounded regeneration
options.body: Approve the 4,096-path cap after live proof confirms bounded memory and documents that owner hashes may rarely change.

options.title: Exclude the secret map
options.body: Bound only the warning caches and keep generated owner-display secrets process-stable until a separate security-owned design is approved.

options.title: Design stable storage
options.body: Replace runtime-only generation with an explicitly approved stable-secret lifecycle, which broadens scope and compatibility review.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded regeneration
recommendation.body: Approve the 4,096-path cap after live proof confirms bounded memory and documents that owner hashes may rarely change.

likelyOwner.reason: This team is the explicit CODEOWNER for the changed config secret module and can decide the HMAC-secret lifetime contract.
